read_parquet_dataset: read a parquet file into a HuggingFace Dataset using ParquetDatasetReader with optional features, split, and filters
read_parquet_datasetdict: read multiple parquet files into a DatasetDict or IterableDatasetDict with per-split paths and streaming support
write_parquet_dataset: write a HuggingFace Dataset to a parquet file using ParquetDatasetWriter with content-defined chunking options
test_parquet_read_filters: test parquet reading with column filters to subset rows during read
test_get_arrow_writer_batch_size: test get_arrow_writer_batch_size_from_features to determine optimal batch size for image and audio datasets
